verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar is an API-driven SaaS product, so scoped or least-privilege agent credentials are a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack documents restricted, scoped, or permission-limited API keys. The official MCP server and CLI probes are different capabilities and do not show credential scoping, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
